title: THE 7-EDGE PROOF — seven consumers CONSUMED on the host, six in the HEADED container under Muse 1.3

container_result.down: L2_ARSUMBRIS (the container has no au daemon), TSG (no key)
container_result.model: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free (opencode-zen-free) per the operator's order

the_model_incident.class: THE MODEL HALLUCINATED A TOOL LIMITATION
the_model_incident.what_happened: the container's model (openrouter/poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free) returned HTTP 429 (rate limit). The agent turn ended with a provider error and NEVER CALLED the tool — yet it wrote a long, confident explanation that gi-consumption 'is not available in my current toolkit'. The log is the evidence: 'agent turn ended with provider error ... 429 Provider returned error'.
the_model_incident.the_lesson: ★ A model's prose about its own capabilities is NOT evidence. The log + the tool result are. Had the model's claim been believed, this would have been recorded as a missing tool — a fabricated blocker.
the_model_incident.the_fix: WARHEAD 6 (the rate-limit switch): re-pinned the container's model

the_proxy_firewall_finding.what: the operator's go-model blacklist (go-session-proxy.mjs:155) whitelists the WIRE name 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor', while omp's catalog wire alias for that model is 'big-pickle' — so opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor was rejected with 403 model_blacklisted.
the_proxy_firewall_finding.the_workaround: the container's own free zen lane (opencode-zen-free/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free) resolves correctly and is what the operator's 'muse 1.3' means in this rig

verdict: PASS — SEVEN consumers CONSUMED on the host (was 2/8 at the session start), SIX in the headed container under Muse 1.3; the one remaining depends on a BILLING state (the TypeSafe key's quota)
